objective: Help HVAC practitioners avoid treating total external static pressure as a direct airflow measurement and lead them to the complete free measurement reference.
coreUserProblem: A static-pressure result is easy to misread as though it directly establishes system CFM.
primaryMessage: TESP is not airflow. A pressure reading can support airflow evaluation only with the correct equipment data and operating conditions.

technicalClaimsSource.section: What airflow and static pressure tell you
supports: Static pressure helps describe the resistance the fan is working against at a particular operating condition.
A pressure reading can support airflow evaluation only with the correct equipment data and operating conditions.

technicalClaimsSource.section: Conceptual pressure relationship — illustrative TESP magnitude example
supports: Example values demonstrate arithmetic only and are not a design target.

technicalClaimsSource.section: Workflow A — Measure total external static pressure
supports: TESP does not independently establish airflow.
One universal pair of probe locations does not apply to every system.

callToAction: Open the free HVAC Airflow & Static Pressure Measurement Quick Reference.
revenueConnection: No direct revenue claim. This free-first campaign is intended to improve qualified discovery and repeat use; any later revenue effect must be measured rather than assumed.
formatRationale: The misconception benefits from seeing pressure relationships rather than reading a static summary, while a carousel provides a quieter saveable alternative. The current motion graphic proves the pipeline but a richer visual story should be selected before publication.
visualConcept: Current prototype: code-driven technical motion graphic. Preferred final direction: a visually richer HVAC-specific story selected from the documented field, conceptual-flow, or exploded-equipment directions.
audioStrategy: The prototype is deliberately silent for pipeline validation. A final video should normally use concise narration with subtle licensed music or relevant ambience unless the selected concept justifies another documented strategy.
mediaRequirements: One technically reviewed primary visual treatment
Commercial-rights provenance for every external visual and audio asset
generationRequirements: Current tools can render titles, diagrams, values, captions, and final assembly
Realistic field footage, cinematic duct visualization, or detailed exploded equipment would require owner-supplied licensed media or a future approved provider
